text.tspan: 3-way merge: two questions, so three inputs
manifest stored in the release Secret
the object in the cluster now
In OLD, not in NEW → delete it
NEW ≠ LIVE → set it to NEW
NEW = LIVE → left out of the patch
"Strategic": built-in lists merge by key (containers and env by name), so kubectl set env survives.
Custom resources have no merge keys: Helm uses a 2-way merge (OLD vs NEW), so a hand edit survives unless the chart changed it.
